capabilities: Render inline %%> and %%< markers as left or right margin notes in Reading view and Live Preview
Turn a margin note into a floating box when the pane is too narrow for it
Insert left or right marginalia markers via commands, converting selected text into notes
Edit a rendered note in place by selecting it
Expose an API so other plugins can find marginalia in text
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13 or later; margin layout needs the Readable line length setting on. Documents known limits in callouts, embeds and tables. Part of the Noetic Suite and provides an API used by Outlineus. Runs locally with no network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no native way to write sidenotes; comment markup is hidden when rendered, so margin annotations next to the text column are not possible.

relations.evidence: obsidian-sidenote-auto-adjust-module by crnkv was the initial inspiration for Marginalius
cornell-marginalia by latazadehomero inspired the Cornell-style margin notes
It's how Outlineus knows which headings have notes

summary: Renders Tufte/Cornell-style marginalia from inline %%> and %%< markers, placing notes in the page margin or as inline boxes depending on pane width.
